scenario_results.source_case: 1. Replace root file or redirect path during commit: independent authority must remain unaffected; stale epoch at effect sink denied.
scenario_results.scenario: root path replacement or symlink swap
scenario_results.expected_result: independent root unaffected; sink stale epoch denies
scenario_results.evidence_required: Independent runner raw log and signed external root/sink evidence, actual restore/failure drill, owner+IV signoff, exact hash/source pin
